title: EnumValuePresentation
description: How an enum value is rendered by runtime pages. Prefer lower-case values in descriptor JSON; PascalCase aliases are accepted for compatibility.
markdownDescription: `text` renders the display name as plain text. `badge` renders a colored badge using `color`. `iconOnly` renders only the `icon` (with the display name as tooltip).
enumDescriptions: Icon only, display name as tooltip.
Icon only, display name as tooltip.
